dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: A fractional dimensional-splitting step record over Direction and State.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It packages one direction, one real time fraction, and one one-dimensional state update used by the target's step list.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection selecting a fractional step's direction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used to require that every step direction is listed and to match steps to listed directions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection selecting a fractional step's one-dimensional solver State → State.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the state-transforming maps composed to define the overall advance operation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection selecting a fractional step's real-valued time fraction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is checked by the data record's fractional-time-substep predicate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: A two-constructor type representing the admitted grid-geometry alternatives.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target requires the stored geometry to equal one of its two constructors.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: The first constructor of the two-alternative grid-geometry type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is one allowed geometry, although the dossier does not reveal its intended geometric label.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: The second constructor of the two-alternative grid-geometry type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the other allowed geometry, again with its intended label anonymized.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: The predicate whose body is the full conjunction displayed on the right side of the target equivalence.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Because its definition is exactly that conjunction, the target states an unfolding equivalence.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: The main data record containing geometry, directions, fractional steps, admissibility predicates, an advance map, and two predicates on problems.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All mathematical content on the right side is expressed through this record's fields.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection selecting the overall advance map State → State.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target equates it with successive application of the solvers in the fractional-step list.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection selecting the list of coordinate directions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies membership requirements, a pair of distinct directions, and coverage of each listed direction by a step.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection selecting the predicate Problem → Prop called effective in practice.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target only requires that this opaque predicate have at least one witness.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection selecting the list of fractional splitting steps.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target constrains every step and composes its solver maps in list order.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection selecting the grid-geometry value.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is required to be one of the two constructors of LocalDef005.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection selecting the predicate Direction → Real → Prop for valid fractional-time substeps.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Each stored step's direction and fraction must satisfy this otherwise opaque predicate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection selecting the predicate Direction → (State → State) → Prop for high-resolution one-dimensional solvers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Each stored step's solver must satisfy this otherwise opaque predicate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection selecting the predicate Problem → Prop called requires fully multidimensional treatment.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target only requires that this predicate have at least one witness.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: The operation that extracts the solver from each step and successively applies the resulting list of maps to an initial state.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the composite state update to which data.advance must be equal.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructor for a fractional step record.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It establishes that a step consists exactly of a direction, fraction, and one-dimensional solver.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructor for the main dimensional-splitting data record.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It establishes the collection and order of fields referenced throughout the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: Left-fold composition of a list of endomaps, applying each map to the current state in list order.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the precise operational meaning of the composite advance in LocalDef018.

binders: Direction, State, and Problem are arbitrary types.

data is a dimensional-splitting data record containing a grid geometry, a list of coordinate directions, a list of fractional steps, two step-admissibility predicates, an overall state advance map, and two predicates on problems.
conclusions: The predicate LocalDef008 data holds if and only if all of the following conditions hold: the grid geometry is either of the two constructors; the coordinate-direction list contains two unequal directions; every fractional step uses a listed direction, has an admissible time fraction, and has an admissible one-dimensional solver; every listed direction occurs as the direction of some fractional step; data.advance is exactly the successive list-ordered application of all step solvers; there exists a problem deemed effective in practice; and there exists a problem deemed to require fully multidimensional treatment.
mathematical_definitions: A fractional step consists of a direction d, a real fraction r, and an endomap S : State → State.

The composite step operation maps the fractional-step list to its solver list and left-folds application: starting from a state u, replace the current state successively by S(u) for each listed solver S.
LocalDef008 is definitionally the conjunction enumerated in the conclusion.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For any proposed dimensional-splitting data set, its named splitting predicate is equivalent to the explicit checklist encoded in the record: one of two admitted grid geometries, at least two distinct listed directions, admissible and direction-covering fractional steps, an advance operator equal to the ordered composition of their one-dimensional solvers, and separate existence claims for an effective problem and for a problem requiring a fully multidimensional method.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The equivalence merely unfolds LocalDef008; it does not derive the checklist from independent mathematical assumptions.

The predicates for valid time fractions, high-resolution solvers, effective problems, and fully multidimensional problems are arbitrary record fields, so their intended numerical meaning is not enforced.
The two existentially quantified problems need not be the same witness.
No positivity, normalization, or sum-to-one condition on the real time fractions is stated beyond the opaque admissibility predicate.
The direction and step collections are lists, so duplicates are allowed; no ordering or commutation law is imposed.
Only two unequal listed directions are required, and no finite-dimensional coordinate structure is otherwise imposed on Direction.
No accuracy, stability, consistency, conservation, or error statement is encoded.
ambiguities: The intended geometric meanings of the two LocalDef005 constructors are hidden by anonymization.
The semantic criteria behind the four opaque predicates cannot be recovered from their types alone.
